definition: The process of selecting, transforming, or creating input variables (features) to improve a machine learning model's performance.
details: Feature engineering was central to classical machine learning pipelines; deep learning has reduced (but not eliminated) its importance by allowing models to learn useful features directly from raw data.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. Here is the short version: The process of selecting, transforming, or creating input variables (features) to improve a machine learning model's performance. The part that makes it sing: Feature engineering was central to classical machine learning pipelines; deep learning has reduced (but not eliminated) its importance by allowing models to learn useful features directly from raw data. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. And that is Feature Engineering — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
